tenderAddress.blockNumber: Estate Office, Krishi Nagar, UAS, Dharwad

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenderers are advised to note the qualification criteria specified in section-VII to qualify for award of the contract
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by the Government Institutes / Universities etc.,

If the tenderer is a manufacturer, he must have manufactured, tested and supplied the similar to the type specified in the Schedule of requirements upto atleast 80% of the requirement. However, it will be 40% with respect to Micro & Small Enterprises in any one of the last 3 years (2 years for Micro and Small Enterprises). The equipments offered for supply must be of the most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. The models should be of latest model and be in satisfactory operation for last 12 months as on date of tender opening

EMD: The Participating bidder will have to pay Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) Compulsorily through e-Procurement Portal by anyone of the modes as specified in the e-procurement system. Micro and small enterprises registered with NSIC under a single point vendor registration scheme, shall be facilitated by providing tenders sets free of cost, exempting from payment of EMD during purchases by all government department and state owned PSUs. However, the agencies claiming EMD Exemption should enclose the letter of confirmation about the agency. . . . . (Name of the Agency) is eligible for exemption of EMD for supply of items from the competent authority, alongwith NSIC Certificate. The bidders having only MSME Udyam Registration Certificate have to compulsorily make the payment of the EMD. Non-compliance by the Tenderer to any conditions will entail rejection of the tender and forfeiture of the EMD.EMD will be returned to the bidders after finalization of the bid

The details of the tender can be had & downloaded through e-Procurement portal http://kppp.karnataka.gov.in and the bidders have to participate in tender online only. Bidders have to get updated with the corrigendum/addendum (if any) issued online from time to time on the e-Procurement Portal during the entire tender process
The tenderer should make presentation before the technical committee if required. The technical committee will evaluate the same before finalizing the tender
Technical Bid: The Technical bid should be complete in all respects and contain all information about the work as per the tender specifications. It should not contain any price
The successful tenderers would be responsible for imparting at least 2 training sessions to the end users after successful installation
The successful bidder has to complete the work within 2 months. from the date of placing the work order

The Purchaser reserves the right to accept or reject any tender, based on the product quality and specification. During the supply and installation by the successful bidder, the work will be tested by the purchaser and third party inspection will also be conducted
Bidders must upload all the required documents, otherwise the tender shall be considered as non responsive

Commercial Bid: Commercial bid as specified in the e-Procurement system shall be submitted electronically. The bidder should quote the price including Transportation, freight, erection, installation, commissioning with necessary foundation work etc., trial run, training, technical and mechanical assistance & any other Charges for completing the project, in the required format as specified in the e-procurement system and GST CGST and such taxes will be extra and applicable as on the date of work order. The financial bid should be on entire work as 1Unit and include supply, transportation, erection and installation, trail & testing and operation etc., All the items should be considered as one unit for the financial bid.

It is the responsibility of successful bidder to obtain Electrical Power Sanction from HESCOM & GOK approval if any. The Tenderer / Contractor / Agency has to upload the documents of Class-I Electrical Contractor License, Electrical Supervisor License and wireman license permit for carryout the electrical work with undertaking letter from electrical contractor to be enclosed. It is the responsibility of the agency to obtain necessary Certification from pollution control board / competent authority if required.
The quantity shown in the tender is approximate and liable to vary

Successful Tenderer has to deposit a sum equal to 5% of the total value of the quoted price as Security Deposit in addition to Earnest Money Deposit. Security Deposit will be returned after 5 years warranty period and completion of warranty period and satisfactory working of equipment. The SD and EMD amount will not earn any interest

The successful Tenderer shall execute an agreement on a stamp paper of Rs.500/- agreeing to the conditions of tender within the stipulated period. If the Tenderer does not comply the said condition within the stipulated period, the tender will be rejected and EMD and Security Deposits will be forfeited.

In respect of imported equipment, exchanges if any, collected by the bank outside the country has to be borne by the supplier himself. Further, the successful Tenderer should arrange to clear the consignment from customs authorities at their own cost, including customs Duty, clearing charges etc., The suppliers are also responsible for having the equipment duly insured and to deliver them to the F.O.R. Destination as per requirement.
In case of any dispute arising out of this contract, the decision of the University is final
Mode of Payment : Payment will be made only after satisfactory completion of the work and after certification from the user department and third party inspection satisfactory report if necessary.

The University reserves the right to accept, reject or postpone any or all of the Tenders without assigning any reasons thereof. The agencies may please note that, the university is at its discretion to withdraw any or all the items invited under the subject notification at any time.
All disputes arising out of or in any way connected with the Agreement shall be deemed to have arisen in the court of Dharwad jurisdiction.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The TDS under GST and IT as applicable will be deducted from the bill during the payment

The successful bidder has to maintain the entire solar roof top grid connected power plants for the period of 5 years. The security deposit will be refunded only after successful completion of 5 years period.
Prospective bidders shall attend the pre-bid meeting compulsorily and visit the site before pre-bid meeting.
Firms under common ownership should not participate in the same tender. If the partners / proprietors of the firms are identical, they are not allowed to participate in the same tender.

IT Returns The tenderer should have submitted IT returns for the Last 3 years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26

Separate statement of compliance for the tender specifications and deviations if any alongwith explanation shall be clearly mentioned in the proforma provided. VI. A
Technical specifications information of the Section-VI including product brand / make/ module and warranty period. Literature, brochure, catalogues etc., of the work / equipment should be provided
The agencies shall submit the signed documents of all sections of K/G-1 standard tender documents uploaded by the purchaser in e-procurement portal
Undertaking by the vendor in the prescribed format Section VIII Tender Form of KG-I

Users certificates of work completion / supplies / Installations of similar nature for the last 3 financial years supplied to various Government / Quasi Government Organizations /Autonomous Institutions/ Universities as per Section- VII QUALIFICATION CRITERIA of K/G-I
Valid Address, Email. ID, Contact Person, Contact No., for correspondence and placing the supply order
Vendors shall mention the period required for completion of the entire project or work under the tender notification in their technical bid
